With 85 lifts and 0 runs listed, it is a destination that can absorb all tourist flows without ever feeling crowded. St. Anton am Arlberg's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, a well-organised childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. With a summit at 2811 m and a village at 1304 m, snow reliability at St. Anton am Arlberg is generally dependable from January to the end of March. A few exceptionally mild winters can cause tension early in the season, but the situation usually recovers quickly with the first substantial snowfalls. The budget for a stay at St. Anton am Arlberg is clearly high: 82€ per day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence, but be aware of it before you go. In short: St. Anton am Arlberg lives up to its promises. A Northern Alps resort that will suit most profiles without disappointing.
